free_tier.stated: Per Development Mode title: Profile storage 2 GB, Content and configuration storage 2 GB, 5 GB UGC storage. 10 Development Mode titles per studio. Game Saves adds 256 MB per player per title.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: 256 MB per player for Game Saves; request-rate: 100 service endpoint requests per 2-minute period per title player (≈10 uploads/min); 1,000 unique lifetime users per Development Mode title; per-object-cap on UGC requests tiered by request body size. Retention: none stated — data persists until deleted, no expiry clause found.

egress.terms: Billed by API request, not by byte, for the core services. Data Connections egress is metered (Same Region West US 2 = Free; Zone 1 intra-continental $0.02/GB). Development Mode: 'As long as your title is in Development Mode, consumption isn't counted towards any of your billable meters.'

tooling: PlayFab REST APIs (Client/Server/Admin/Entity), official C#/Unity/JS SDKs. No rclone backend; a wrapper is ~50 lines against `https://<titleId>.playfabapi.com/`.
chaining: 4 GB (2 GB profile + 2 GB content) x 10 dev titles = 40 GB per studio, and studios are free and unlimited -> unbounded in aggregate. The sharper multiplier is Game Saves: 256 MB per player x 1,000 players per dev title = 256 GB per title x 10 titles = 2.5 TB per studio, and player identities are free to mint via LoginWithCustomID.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 256 MB per player for Game Saves; request-rate: 100 service endpoint requests per 2-minute period per title player (≈10 uploads/min); 1,000 unique lifetime users per Development Mode title; per-object-cap on UGC requests tiered by request body size. Retention: none stated — data persists until deleted, no expiry clause found.
reliability_note: Titles in Development Mode cannot add users past 1,000 and must be launched (moved to a paid plan) to scale; Game Saves quota overrun throttles writes rather than erroring.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Title players are limited to 256MB of storage per title' and '100 service endpoint requests in any 2-minute period' (page ms.date 2025-06-24)
